$comment: Curated reference data for companies traded on the Nairobi Securities Exchange. This file contains IDENTITY AND CLASSIFICATION ONLY — no prices, volumes or financial statistics. Sector values map to data/sectors.json slugs and follow the NSE official market segment naming. Prices live in data/demo-baseline.json (clearly labelled sample data) or arrive from a licensed feed. Corrections against the official NSE listed-companies register are welcome.

source.name: Curated public company register (NSE listed companies)
source.caveat: Subset of the NSE universe (~60+ listed securities) and not independently audited.
